intro: We're missing the Master Cover! Without Enzo's original design, the NSPC judges won't even open the file!
Enzo said he hid a physical backup—a USB drive—somewhere in this office in case the school server got wiped.
The countdown clock is ticking! We have to find that drive before the submission window closes!
outro: He wanted professional-grade standards. That's exactly what's in this bag.
Tell the rest of the team to get some rest... tomorrow, we take our paper back.
